title: P0.83: Web Perception Concept Resolver + Shared CDP Response Capture
description: Convert live web page observations into structured concepts before action, and reuse the selected governed/user-approved CDP session for ChatGPT response capture instead of opening a new isolated profile.
reason: Live Windows audit on 2026-06-01 showed IABV could open a governed ChatGPT window and CDP could observe DOM, but the runtime still lacked a shared concept frame for page state and the runner did not reuse the selected CDP session. It also rejected intentionally short responses such as 'S'.
next_action: Run a live ChatGPT consultation through the governed CDP session. Expected: metadata includes visual_concepts, visual_unresolved_fields, shared_cdp=true, and a short 'S' response is accepted when the prompt asked for it.
resume_hint: UniversalPerceptionService.build_web_page_signal now emits concepts such as target_bound, login_screen_candidate, chat_input_ready, submit_control_missing, security_verification_candidate, response_captured and unresolved fields. UIExecutionRunner now uses IABV_PREFER_CDP_SESSION/IABV_SHARED_CDP_URL for browser_dom capture.
